definitions.explanation: A Buddhist temple on the hillside of Higashiyama in eastern Kyoto, founded in the late eighth century and now a World Heritage site. It is famous for its main hall's great wooden veranda, {清水|きよみず}の{舞台|ぶたい}, built out over a steep slope.

examples.japanese: {清水寺|きよみずでら}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
{清水寺|きよみずでら}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}える→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: You can see the city of Kyoto from the veranda of Kiyomizu-dera.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{十二月|じゅうにがつ}→十二月：00636_juunigatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{清水寺|きよみずでら}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}される→発表する：25231_happyousuru⟧。
examples.english: Every December, the Kanji of the Year is announced at Kiyomizu-dera.

notes:
Note the reading きよみず, not しみず, although {清水|しみず} is the usual reading of the word for spring water and of the family name.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {清水|きよみず}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{舞台|ぶたい}→舞台：03606_butai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{飛|と}び{降|お}りる→飛び降りる：06734_tobioriru⟧: to take the plunge, to make a bold decision

CULTURAL NOTE:
One of Kyoto's most visited sights, and a standard stop on school trips. The slopes leading up to it, lined with souvenir and pottery shops, are part of the experience.
